tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground of every screen, the black title card and the command bar. Type cards are 79-97% this colour.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised dark surfaces: clock bezel, log, dialog body, slot frame, graph board.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Hover fill of rows, tabs, nav links and seats; the idle hexagon.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, report grid gutters. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Structural rules: bezel edge, unlit cells, graph major lines, input edges (3:1 on void).

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The graph board's minor grid. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Type on void and panel; the black card's type.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary type on void and panel: English captions, nav labels, meta.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Tertiary type on void and panel: timestamps, disabled labels, placeholders (still 4.5:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Data ink: clocks, labels, lit mode cells, the main trace, primary buttons (measured #FBBA30 / #E39626 / #D6B263).

tokens.name: amber-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and press of amber fills.

tokens.name: amber-dim
tokens.usage: Labels of unlit plates and the idle danger cell on panel.

tokens.name: amber-wash
tokens.usage: Hover fill of ghost and mode cells (amber at 15% on void).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Drop-shadow glow of the clock digits.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The one main colour: warning band, danger fills, current nav rule, thresholds, alert buttons; text in it only from 24px (measured #E92D0B on the film title).

tokens.name: alert-strong
tokens.usage: Hover of alert fills.

tokens.name: alert-dim
tokens.usage: The dark half of the 1 Hz band and danger blink.

tokens.name: alert-ink
tokens.usage: Red-orange text under 24px on void and panel: errors, dissent, thresholds.

tokens.name: alert-deep
tokens.usage: The darker film-title red (measured #66041A misses 3:1 on black, lifted).

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Type and icons on alert fills.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Type and icons on amber fills.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: Alarm hexagon fill (measured #BA0623).

tokens.name: alarm-strong
tokens.usage: Hover of an interactive alarm hexagon.

tokens.name: alarm-rule
tokens.usage: Alarm hexagon double rule. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Type on alarm hexagons (measured #EDE4E0).

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: The alarm wall's screen under the hexagons (measured blues #49688B / #9EB2C0, darkened).

tokens.name: screen-deep
tokens.usage: Empty monitor ground of an art slot.

tokens.name: lattice
tokens.usage: The 45-degree lattice on the screen and the slot grid (used at 45%). Decorative.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The inverse card ground (measured on the white card); hovered report cards.

tokens.name: on-paper
tokens.usage: Type on paper.

tokens.name: blood
tokens.usage: The red card's ground.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The one 'normal' state tag; never a fill.

tokens.name: ok-deep
tokens.usage: Fill of a hexagon in the normal state.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline on void, panel, alarm and screen (3:1 on each).
